stories.title: Anthropic CEO commits to independent safety oversight, calls for AI development slowdown
new_facts: Names whistleblower Jacob Coxon whose viral resignation warned of AI's existential threat, prompting Amodei's essay
New Amodei quotes from essay: 12 years in AI, belief AI could cure most major diseases in 5-10 years
Elon Musk publicly endorses Amodei's pacing argument, saying "Dario is right"
Amodei warns swarms of rogue AI agents could take over the internet within as little as six months
Names METR as the third-party evaluator Anthropic will grant model access to
Amodei clarifies 'pacing' AI development means safeguarding time, not halting training or progress.
Anthropic unilaterally commits to giving third-party evaluators permanent, employee-level system access.
Amodei proposes three-part plan: embedded evaluators, democratic coordination, and coordination with authoritarian governments.
stories.line: Anthropic's CEO calls for slowing AI development and proposes independent safety oversight of his own company.
